summary: @servicetitan/cp-mfe 1.115.2 preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs checks for a local Bun install; if absent, it downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip, chmods it to 0o755, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (string-array + rotating-index shuffle, hex-named identifiers, custom-alphabet base64-like decoder, @bun/@bun-cjs header) shipped in the tarball but not referenced by the package's public API — dist/ only exports a ~10KB portal.store micro-frontend library. The obfuscated payload is executed only through the preinstall hook via the fetched Bun runtime, evading Node-based static inspection. Advertised purpose (a ServiceTitan MFE portal store) has no need for an alternate JS runtime or a payload of this size and shape, consistent with a compromised release of the @servicetitan scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
